note: `fresh_bridge`, `balance_rate` and `algebra_rate` carry the averaged error (W-h-1)α, the telescoping over j ≤ D and the final rate Wα-(D+1)(α-β)+Vυ; the rotation-orbit Haar average is replaced by `checkReal` averages and a Reader.

lemma fresh_bridge: RateLE φ A (fun i=> R.fresh n (x i) (o i) v - R.cutTest n H (Z i)) ((weight d-H-1)*a):=by
    have hv:=bridge_averaged (v:=v) U R h hA hx hk ha H n; apply (pay_fixed hA ((R.knife n).restrictScalars ℝ) hv).congr; filter_upwards with i
    let g:Labels S (fun _:Unit=>H):=sole (Z i); let c:=o i
    have hh: checkReal P R.law R.continuum n (sole c) c g = checkReal P R.law R.continuum n (sole 0) 0 g:=by
        apply Eq.trans ?_ (checkReal_transfer n R.law R.continuum _ _ _ c); rw [zero_add,(show (fun i:Unit=>sole (0:E4) i+c)=sole c from funext (fun _=>zero_add _))]
    simp only [map_sub]; change _ - R.knife n (checkReal P R.law R.continuum n (sole c) c g) = _; rw [hh]; rfl

proof_context.conclusion: `fresh_bridge` bounds `R.fresh n - R.cutTest n H` by the rate `(weight d-H-1)*a`, the averaged error.

lemma balance_rate (m:ℕ)(hba:b < a):RateLE φ A (fun i=>balance U (spectator U (z i)) R m (x i) (o i) v (y i) w) (weight d*a-(m+1:ℝ)*(a-b)+weight e*c) :=by
    let q i:= shadowOld P m (x i) (o i) v; let W i:=discrepancy (spectator U (z i)) m (x i) (o i) v (q i) (y i) w
    let L'(j:ℕ)(i:L):S.Field j→ₗ[ℂ] ℂ:=upon (spectator U (z i)) j (o i) (y i) w
    let f (j:Fin (m+1))(i:L):=R.fresh j.val (x i) (o i) v
    let E (j:Fin (m+1)) i:= L' (j.val:ℕ) i (R.cutTest j.val m (q i)- f j i)
    have hid i(hi:Injective (beside (sole (o i)) (y i))): W i+ (∑ j:Fin (m+1), E j i)=balance U (spectator U (z i)) R m (x i) (o i) v (y i) w:=by
        have he: W i=whole (spectator U (z i)) (x i) v (y i) w- L' m i (q i):=rfl
        have hz:L' m i (q i) = ∑ j:Fin (m+1), L' _ i (R.cutTest j.val m (q i)):=by
              have hu:= R.reconstruct m m (le_refl m) (q i); rw [(Q|>.arrival R.continuum.laws.toSymmetric R.lifts)] at hu; apply Eq.trans (congr_arg (L' m i) hu.symm) (by rw [map_sum]; unfold L'; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj=>upon_rise U R _ _ _ _ _ _ hi)) -- rw fails
        rw [he,hz]; unfold balance E; simp_rw [map_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; change _ = whole _ _ _ _ _ - ∑ j,L' _ i (f j i); abel
    let ξ:= weight d*a-(m+1:ℝ)*(a-b)+weight e*c
    have hx2:= (clearance_both hA hx hk hp hy hba hc).1
    have hf:=discrepancy_rate_old U R h hA z v w hx hk hp hy ha hb hba hc m
    refine (hf.add (RateLE.sum hA (f:=E) (fun j hj=>?_)) hA).congr <| hx2.mono hid
    have h':=(fresh_bridge (v:=v) U R h hA hx hk ha m j.val).neg.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun i=> (neg_sub (f j i) (R.cutTest _ m (q i)))) -- orientation rate neg.congr expects Eq?
    exact (upon_field_cost U h hA z w hp hy hb hc j.val _ _ h').mono (by have hi : (j.val:ℝ) ≤ m+1:=(by exact_mod_cast j.isLt.le); linarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hb])

proof_context.conclusion: `balance_rate` telescopes the truncated error into the discrepancy plus a sum over `j` of tested `fresh_bridge` errors, with rate `weight d*a-(m+1)*(a-b)+weight e*c`.

lemma algebra_rate (m:ℕ): RateLE φ A (fun i=> algebraError U R (x i) (o i) v (y i) w m) (weight d*a-(m+1:ℝ)*(a-b)+weight e*c):=by
   obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩:= clearance_both hA hx hk hp hy hba hc
   let f(k:K)(v':Viewers U):= balance U (spectator U v') R m (x k) (o k) v (y k) w
   have ht(v'):= balance_rate U R h hA v hx hk ha v' w hp hy hb hc m hba
   intro s hs; filter_upwards [universalize (p:=fun k v'=> ‖f k v'‖ ≤ Real.exp (s*A k)) (fun v'=> ht v' s hs), h₂,h₁] with i he hi ho
   exact (glance_contract U (Real.exp_nonneg _)).2 (fun t => by rw [see_algebra]; exacts [he t, hi, ho])

proof_context.conclusion: `algebra_rate` gives the final remainder rate for every viewer in the algebra.
